Comment: Amazon Reviews 2023 x AmazonQAC: 300M of the 560M deduplicated documents, a uniform random subset (scripts/data/subset_base.py, seed 20261103), 768-d int8, 1% heads, 64-byte PQ codes; the queries are the first 2M searches of the QAC stream, in time order. The warmup of every run that starts on 4 nodes: deploys them and saves the snapshot of their raw vectors those runs then start on (scripts/run_local.py, type: warmup), on the CloudLab control node from the page file, on the CPU backend, without memory limits. StageTimeout 3h and ReadyTimeoutSeconds 14400: each node copies its raw vectors (up to 96.9M) from the page file a page at a time, and the deployment took 72 minutes (4,296 s, 2026-11-07), past config.yaml's 30-minute StageTimeout, which stopped the first try.
